headline: Rohit scores 138 in third ODI at Lord's
description: A 138-run innings against England highlighted Rohit's 2026 ODI campaign.

headline: Rohit makes 79 against Afghanistan
description: Rohit produced a 79 off 69 balls in India's third ODI against Afghanistan.

headline: BCCI congratulates Rohit on Test career
description: BCCI marked the end of a 67-Test career spanning 4,301 runs and 12 centuries.

headline: T20 World Cup triumph closes T20I chapter
description: Rohit retired from T20Is after captaining India to the 2024 title.
